author: HP_Superman101
body: My name is HP_Superman101 and i was banned from avicus. I wrote an appeal to get me unbanned and there was a senior mod who said i would be forgiven and let back in into avicus. since then i have not been unbanned. please unban me. i love to play on the server and its been 5 months since i got banned

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Hello,

Sorry that you were not appealed. I will make sure to appeal you right this instant! Welcome back to Avicus!

Thanks,
Iron,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
